SELECT c.reg_id, c.p_reg_id, c.code, c.name, NULL AS p_code, NULL AS p_name FROM tb_reg c
c.p_reg_id IS NULL
AND c.code = #{code}
AND c.name LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
AND c.status = 'Y'
ORDER BY c.reg_id
SELECT c.reg_id, c.p_reg_id, c.code, c.name, p.code AS p_code, p.name AS p_name FROM tb_reg c LEFT JOIN tb_reg p ON p.reg_id = c.p_reg_id WHERE c.status = 'Y' ORDER BY c.level, c.code, c.reg_id
